scope: Version 15 integrates the three completed 5:1 N3 numerical reviews and the combined comparative conclusions. Exact parameter definitions, primary sources, code anchors and numeric-choice acceptance are unchanged. Numerical evidence is distinct from a quantitative biological basis.

entries.name: Recent secretion state
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: Positive half-life15min controls the latent recent-activity state, not secretion shutoff. After input ceases, s(M)=10*M^2/(25+M^2), so its half-output time is (h/2)*log2(2+(M0/5)^2), dependent on M0. The h=0 implementation is a history-weighted recent-delivery gate, not the h->0+ limit.

entries.name: Source and normalization
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: Smax10/min,K_M5,n2,saturation1. The source is volume-scaled S*(1-C), not a constant molecule flux. For an illustrative closed well-mixed system with fixed initial cell counts/volumes, all sources at cap10/min and no loss, alpha=N*2494*10/3.456e9 permin. This gives half-saturation160.085min for600CAR and400.213min for240CAR. Actual activation, proliferation/death, spatial transport and exchange invalidate treating these benchmarks as measured secretion or trajectories. The latent-state-to-source Hill nonlinearity separates memory half-life from output half-time. IFNg/TNF have the same central relative fields; identical molecular kinetics or independently measured contributions are not established.

historical_allocation_anchor.reason: Allocation/declaration of secretion_rates; not the active source equation.

entries.name: IFNg priming
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: Maximum conversion0.0029/min,K0.25,n2. At saturation its exponential median is ln2/.0029=239.016min; an observation window is not measurement of this rate. Actual conversion uses a discrete probability rate*dt on the phenotype schedule, with previously applied rule values; the exponential limit is a mathematical benchmark. No reversal is represented.

entries.name: Delayed cytokine response
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: Two equal stages tau720min give mean lag1440min. Added saturated hazard ln2/1440 gives50% isolated nondividing survival over24h once stages are fully established. These are explicit modeling definitions. Starting from zero latent states is distinct from established hazard: at formal unit occupancy, the model extra-survival half-time is about46.54h; the filter step reaches half plateau at about20.14h. These are defined-model calculations, not experimental timing.

entries.name: Effective target repair
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: t_half=56.7 min; r=ln(2)/56.7=0.012224817999293567 /min. Source interval33.1-112.2 min motivates slow/fast challenges without tuning observed curve order.

entries.name: Recognition-conditioned direct attack
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: AgHi0.1/min; Ag0 zero. AgLo has nonzero attack in definitions but is not reachable in the current populations.

entries.name: Attack dwell
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: Active CD4/CD8 use mean uncensored modeled dwell15min at a0.1min interaction step: probability dt/(15+1e-15). The implied median is10.4min and95th percentile44.8min before competing termination. This derives the software meaning, not a biological choice of15min.

entries.name: Damage-to-death law
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: Maximum0.023/min,K45 internal damage units,Hill16, coupled to delivery1damage unit/min and repair. Joint rescaling of damage, delivered history, activation memory, delivery rate and all associated thresholds changes the coordinate convention; it does not identify threshold ratios or Hill/hazard parameters. The active-cell delivered counter is preserved/inherited and would reset on exhausted conversion; that conversion is disabled in current scenarios.

entries.name: Movement
entries.numeric_argument_and_origin: Active CAR-T speed1um/min,persistence5min,bias0.5; 2D versus3D random direction flags explicit. External CAR-T mean displacement5.9um/7min gives apparent0.843um/min, supporting a rounded scale hypothesis, not exact propulsion calibration. Under fixed unit gradient the ideal forward drift is2/pi in2D and2/3 in3D for speed1 and bias0.5; these are not measured trajectories.
